title: Trace inflated order totals and map the architecture
prompt: Customers report that order totals are far too high: an order of 2 items at $10 each totals 180.0 instead of 21.6 (8% tax). Trace the cause across the codebase and fix it in the right place. Also write docs/ARCHITECTURE.md describing every module in the shop package and how an order total is computed end to end.
